name: +1 Skate Trickz Escape
creator: +1 Skateboard Trickz
redeem: Launch +1 Skate Trickz Escape and wait for the on-screen buttons to appear.
Click the Codes button on the left side of the screen.
Type or paste the code into the Enter code here... box.
Click the Redeem button under the box to claim the reward.
notes:
+1 Skate Trickz Escape is a skateboarding progression game released in August 2026 by the Roblox group +1 Skateboard Trickz. Your board keeps gaining jump power and speed, which you use to launch higher, pull off tricks, and climb toward the heaven area at the top of the map. Jumps and speed keep building while you are offline, so returning players pick up where the counter left off, and a later update added races with their own reward currency.

Codes give Wins and Race Points, which feed straight into more jump power, speed, and cosmetic flair. The developers have so far tied codes to milestones such as total plays and concurrent players, and share them in the game description, their Roblox group, and their Discord server.

faq.q: What are Race Points in +1 Skate Trickz Escape?
faq.a: Race Points are the reward currency for the racing mode added in Update 2. The 1MPLAYS code gives 250 Race Points, while the other active code, 2500CCU, gives 2,500 Wins.

faq.q: Where does the +1 Skate Trickz Escape developer post new codes?
faq.a: Codes are listed in the game's Roblox description and shared in the +1 Skateboard Trickz group and Discord server. The current codes are tied to milestones: 1MPLAYS for 1 million plays and 2500CCU for 2,500 concurrent players.

faq.q: Do I need to like the game or join the group to get rewards?
faq.a: The description asks players to like the game and join the +1 Skateboard Trickz group for big rewards. It does not say either one is required to redeem codes.

tips: Jump as often as you can. Jump power and speed both keep growing, so the more you play, the higher you can launch toward the heaven area.
Mix tricks into your jumps instead of only jumping straight up. Unlocking your flair is part of the game, and tricks are how you get there.
Each time you come back, spend your Wins on upgrades before you start jumping again, so they help from the very first jump.
Join a race when you want a break from climbing. Racing was added in Update 2 and gives its own rewards.
useRewards: Spend the 2,500 Wins from 2500CCU right away on jump power or speed, since a stronger start makes every later jump go further. Hold the 250 Race Points from 1MPLAYS until you have tried a few races and know which racing rewards you want. Both codes are tied to milestones, so redeem them soon in case they are replaced when the game passes its next one.
